//: Chromium web apps (chromeless --app windows). Read by bin/webapp, bin/url-router
and the open-external extension (via its native host; changes apply live).
name, comment, categories, icon  launcher entry (run `webapp sync` after edits);
icon is a theme name, e.g. icons/hicolor/*/apps/<icon>.png
url             what the app window opens; also identifies its window
hosts           the app's own sites: links to them stay inside the app
external_links  links the app opens in new tabs/windows go to the system URL handler
capture         regexes (POSIX ERE) of links from anywhere that load in this app's
open window, or open it first
keep_hosts: sign-in and other sites that always stay in Chromium.
